title: Review live trigger flashlight intensity controls
objective: Review Builder's live flashlight trigger intensity controls for runtime correctness, bounds behavior, test coverage, and regression risk.
instructions: Review the new gamepad analog trigger handling and verify left trigger decreases and right trigger increases intensity.
Check the runtime SetIntensity call shape against existing SPEAR/Unreal usage patterns; flag if it may fail against the real component API.
Check parsing/default bounds/rate/deadzone behavior for realistic/default profiles.
Run python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation and any cheap syntax/import checks needed.
constraints: Do not modify files unless a small review fix is clearly needed and in scope.
Do not perform Git commits or pushes.

artifacts: Live flashlight teleop now supports bounded analog trigger intensity adjustment on the existing SpotLightComponent via --intensity-adjust-rate, --intensity-min, --intensity-max, and trigger/deadzone flags.

expected_outputs: Findings first, with file/line references for any issue.
definition_of_done: Feature is approved or concrete blocking issues are reported.
